title: Desk Training Questions: On-Campus Resident Courtesy on Extension Nights
content:
**Rule.** The on-campus resident courtesy on added nights of an extension under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is five percent (5 percent) of the care increase for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency is at the same community as the stay, two percent (2 percent) for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency is at another community, and nothing for any other guest.

## Questions answered

**What does the courtesy reduce?** The care increase on an added night as it stands in the price of an added night — the added-night rate less the nightly rate locked at booking, after any reduction already taken on it. The amount is multiplied by 95 percent at 5 percent and by 98 percent at 2 percent; the nightly rate locked at booking is not reduced.

**Which records decide it?** The guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status and the Larkspur community of that residency, compared with the community of the stay.

**A guest living in independent living at Larkspur at Brookfield extends a respite stay at Larkspur at Brookfield. What applies?** 5 percent.

**The same guest's stay is at another Larkspur community. What applies?** 2 percent.

**The guest gave notice and vacated the independent living apartment before the stay. What applies?** Nothing; the residency is not active.

## Hypothetical illustration

With a locked rate of 239.00 and a care increase of 45.00 as it stands, a guest whose active residency is at the stay's own community has a care increase in the price of 45.00 times 95 percent, that is 42.75, and a price of an added night of 239.00 plus 42.75, that is 281.75.
